messages:
jess (docs): Hey folks  PR #7120 lands a rewrite of the "tiering" docs: moves examples from 'rate tiers' to the new 'usage tiers' concept, updates SDK snippets, and replaces most mentions of "burst credits" with "grace credits". Quick sanity check before I merge? Link: https://confluence.redwood/internal/docs/usage-tiers
omar (eng): I'll review. Two things I want called out: 1) the Prometheus panel ID changed (now `tier-usage-v2`), 2) the pricing table CSV link needs to point to the canonical S3 location.
jess (docs): Good catch on panel id. I replaced the dashboard URL but left the CSV as a relative link. Should we switch to the S3 signed URL or keep relative and let the redirect handle it?
kevin (analytics): Use the canonical S3 path (s3://redwood-public/pricing/usage-tiers.csv) in docs but point readers to the web-hosted copy. I'll add a redirect rule. Also, in the analytics section please include the sample query that teams use to calculate per-plan token consumption. Suggest adding this PromQL snippet:
```
sum(rate(tokens_consumed_total{plan=~"(pro|team|enterprise)"}[5m])) by (plan)
```
This matches our dashboard panels.
jess (docs): Thanks @kevin, I'll paste that into the 'Usage analytics' subsection and call out that metric name is `tokens_consumed_total`. Also adding a short Node fetch example for setting headers to the new `x-rw-usage-plan` header. Draft JS snippet:
```
fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/usage', {
  headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${TOKEN}`, 'x-rw-usage-plan': 'enterprise' }
}).then(r => r.json()).then(console.log)
```
omar (eng): Two tiny nits: 1) in the SDK Python example please use RedwoodClient(timeout=30) to avoid hanging streams in examples, 2) update the feature note: 'grace credits apply before usage charges and do not reset mid-cycle' (shorter phrasing).
ci-bot: docs-ci: lint started for PR #7120
kevin (analytics): Also add a one-liner about pricing slabs: "Usage tiers are billed per-token with slabed rates; see the pricing CSV for slab boundaries." Keeps doc light but links to the CSV.
jess (docs): Will incorporate both edits, add the PromQL snippet, the Node + Python snippets, and the pricing one-liner. I'll point the CSV link to the web-hosted S3 URL and add a small note for redirects from older filenames. @ci-bot can you run lint after I push?
ci-bot: docs-ci: lint passed \u2705
omar (eng): +1
kevin (analytics): +1
jess (docs): Merged PR #7120. Thanks all, closing thread.
